en.title: October 31: Halloween Itself Meets a Muin Day's Castle-Top Earth - 3 Zodiac Animals With the Best Luck
en.excerpt: Halloween has actually arrived, and today's Saju day is named for the earthen wall raised along a fortress parapet to hold the line after dark. Here are the three zodiac animals with the best luck today, and why.

zh.title: 10月31日：万圣节当晚遇上戊寅日的城头土 - 运势最旺的3个生肖

fr.title: 31 octobre : Halloween lui-même rencontre la Terre de Rempart d'un jour Muin - 3 signes du zodiaque chinois avec la meilleure chance

ko.title: 10월 31일, 할로윈 당일과 무인일의 성두토가 만나는 날 - 운 좋은 띠 3가지
